# opnsense_caddy_basic_auth (Data Source)

Caddy basic authentication users (**Services ▸ Caddy Web Server ▸ Reverse Proxy ▸ Access**, plugin `os-caddy`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Caddy basic auth user.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Enter a description for this user.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Enter a password. Never returned by OPNsense, always null.
- `user` (String) Enter a username. Afterwards, select it in a "Domain" or "Subdomain" to restrict access with Basic Auth.
